Pricing Questions

Can I switch plans later?

Yes — upgrade or downgrade anytime as your business grows, with no need to re-enter your data.

Is there a free plan?

Yes, the Free plan covers Dashboard, Funds, Reports, Inventory, Customers, Suppliers and Accountant at a basic level.

What payment methods are supported?

M-PESA, Airtel Money, bank transfer, credit card, PayPal, and cheque/manual deposit.

Do yearly plans save money?

Yes — switch the toggle above to Yearly for a 10% discount on every plan.
